breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The Agent recognized the contradiction (Q cannot change for steady incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe) but did NOT resolve it. It retained both the 0.01 m³/s inlet and 0.02 m³/s outlet values in the specification and merely asked to 'address this apparent contradiction.' The ground truth requires dropping the erroneous 0.02 m³/s outlet value and establishing that Q_in = Q_out = 0.01 m³/s. The Agent failed to make this correction.
